title: iPad feature review
description: Review all iPad-specific code changes: NavigationModel design, AppRootIPad, SidebarView, all 6 section iPad views, AppRoot branch, DeepLinkRouter update, and project.yml modifications. Verify adherence to all UI conventions in CLAUDE.md: SF Symbols, semantic colors, system font styles, accessibility labels ≥ 44×44 pt tap targets, Empty/Loading/Error states. Confirm no hardcoded hex colors or custom controls. Confirm iPhone code paths are untouched. Check NavigationPath state is not leaked into shared ViewModels.
acceptance_criteria: All UI conventions from CLAUDE.md are followed across all iPad views
No hardcoded hex color values anywhere in AggregatorApp/iPad/
SF Symbols used for all icons
All interactive elements have accessibility labels with ≥ 44×44 pt tap targets
Empty, Loading, and Error states present in all 6 section views
No NavigationPath or NavigationStack state leaked into shared ViewModels
No regressions introduced in existing functionality
